reviews.title: Free trap
reviews.text: Free episodes (train,hats) locked after a while. Now my boy already addicted to that episodes. It is cruel addiction market strategy. That was no warning on these initial three that they will lock after a while.

reviews.title: Nothing free about this app
reviews.text: Kids can play at one time and then all of it locks down. It’s really stupid. Don’t say it’s free if it’s not.

reviews.title: Cannot delete
reviews.text: I deleted this app from my phone, it doesn’t show in my apps, storage, anywhere. But I keep getting notifications and when I open them, the app still works. I can’t redownload because the App Store thinks I already own it but I cannot locate it anywhere on my phone to delete it! What kind of weird programming is this?!?

reviews.title: Cant even play but for 10 seconds
reviews.text: You can’t even play but for a few seconds and then you have to pay if your gonna make a game that does that for kids then just make it cost money in the App Store before I buy it

reviews.title: Limited options
reviews.text: Why do I have to pay $70 to use simple apps - educational games for children should not cost money or it should be a one time fee not weekly monthly or yearly
